title: Suffix extraction by a Turing machine
statement: Let $first$ be a Boolean value, and let $x$, $rest$, and $a$ be finite Boolean words. For every pair of Boolean words $pre$ and $out$ such that $x$ is the concatenation of $pre$ and $rest$, running the pair-extraction machine with its second extraction enabled for $|rest|+1$ steps from the configuration whose state is the second-extraction state, whose input head is just after $pre$, whose work tape stores $a$ with its head at position $|a|$, and whose output is $out$, yields a halted configuration with input head just after $x$, the same work tape and head position, and output equal to the concatenation of $out$ and $rest$.
